leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a primary provider function that simulates an API call
Construct a fallback provider function to handle primary provider failures
Configure a retry mechanism to attempt the primary provider before switching
Integrate a health check to monitor provider availability
Manipulate error handling to gracefully switch between providers
Initialize a provider selection strategy based on health status
Apply logging to track provider usage and fallback events
lessonTitle: Build fallback strategy for provider outages
